back_cover_blurb: Walk into your coding interview with a plan.

Top technology companies test the same core skills: recognizing the pattern behind a problem, explaining your thinking, and writing correct code under time pressure. This book teaches all three, with 120 original problems and solutions that were actually run and tested.
- A six-step method for any problem: clarify, examples, brute force, optimize, code, test
- 18 pattern chapters, from hashing and sliding windows to graphs and dynamic programming
- Practical coding, object-oriented design, system design and behavioral interviews
- AI-assisted rounds, take-homes and online assessments
- Four full mock interviews with the interviewer's notes, and two-, six- and twelve-week study plans
Most solutions are checked against a simpler version on thousands of random inputs, and all of them run on Python 3.12 to 3.15. Current as of October 2026.

author_short_bio: Aadhavan Muthurengan is an automation and AI professional with more than 15 years of experience in the automotive industry, where Aadhavan has built in-house tools that transformed product development and validation.
examples_note: Every problem in this book is original. Every solution was run and checked on Python 3.12, 3.13, 3.14 and 3.15. Interview formats described were checked against companies' own published guidance where available, as of October 2026, and change over time.
